item.title: India’s Biggest Hospital has a Chronic Illness
item.description: A parliamentary committee report highlights a severe staff shortage at AIIMS, with over 2,500 vacancies across faculty and medical staff, severely impacting patient care. The report urges the health ministry to expedite recruitment by offering competitive compensation packages and streamlining the hiring process. item.title: Corner Office Conversation: Westlife CEO on Mcdonald’s India Growth Story
item.description: For McDonald’s, India presents a consistent growth in contrasting the headwinds its facing globally. item.title: Corner Office Conversation with Eli Lilly's Global CEO David Ricks
item.description: Eli Lilly has launched Manjaro (Tirzepatide) in India, a major step in addressing rising chronic diseases like obesity and diabetes. In this episode, hosts Vikas and Teena speak with David A. Ricks, CEO of Eli Lilly, and Winselow Tucker, President & GM India, about upcoming launches, competition, and the role of emerging markets. They also discuss strategic partnerships, political challenges like tariffs, and Eli Lilly’s commitment to funding innovation and advancing global healthcare.

item.title: The Financial Mess at Gensol and Blu-Smart
item.description: Once seen as the promising power duo of India’s renewables and EV story, Gensol Engineering and BluSmart Mobility are now at the center of a high-stakes corporate unraveling. item.title: The Influencer Economy’s Quiet Reset
item.description: The influencer economy is undergoing a reset, not least due to recent controversies like “India’s Got Latent”.
